name: zcode-plugin
description: Personal ZCode plugin collection: git-conventions (commit message guard), dev-workflow (development flow skills), guardrails (safety hooks) and websearch (keyless multi-engine search).

plugins.name: git-conventions
plugins.description: Commit message guard: a PreToolUse hook reads the message out of each git commit command and denies it before git runs when it breaks the convention - <type>(<scope>): <subject> within 50 characters, body as dash bullets ending with a Verified: line. Needs node on PATH.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 提交信息规范钩子：PreToolUse 钩子从每条 git commit 命令里读出提交信息，不符合规范就在 git 运行前拦下——标题形如 feat(scope): subject、不超过 50 字符，正文用 - 列表、末行是 Verified:。需要 PATH 里有 node。

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Daily development workflow: 7 flow skills (change-plan, debug, test-changed, review, commit-review, release-check, doc-gen) with each hand-off step naming the subagent to dispatch, task-level plan files under .devflow and docs/plans, a gated multi-round review protocol, /handoff session contract persistence, a SessionStart repo snapshot, and 23 specialist subagents auto-installed into ~/.zcode/agents (they locate code with the codegraph plugin, which must be installed and enabled too).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 日常开发流程：7 个流程 skill（change-plan、debug、test-changed、review、commit-review、release-check、doc-gen），该派发的步骤点名对应子智能体，任务级计划文件落在 .devflow 与 docs/plans，带闸门的多轮审查收敛协议，/handoff 会话契约持久化，SessionStart 仓库快照，另有 23 个专职子智能体自动装进 ~/.zcode/agents（它们用 codegraph 插件定位代码，需要同时安装并启用 codegraph）。

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Deterministic safety hooks: blocks irreversible shell commands (POSIX, cmd.exe and PowerShell) and hardcoded credentials, routes publishing, deploys and migrations to a confirmation prompt. The prompt tier steps aside in full access mode; the blocks never do.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 确定性安全护栏：硬拦不可逆的 shell 命令（POSIX、cmd.exe、PowerShell）与硬编码密钥，发布、部署、迁移转为确认弹窗。确认级在完全访问模式下让行，硬拦从不让行。

plugins.name: websearch
plugins.description: Multi-engine web search for ZCode as a zero-dependency MCP server: AnySearch, Exa, Parallel and Bing chained with automatic fallback, plus a static page reader. Every engine works without a key. Configuration (engine order, per-engine keys) is websearch.json inside the plugin data folder — created automatically on first use, and the tools report its exact path, so just ask the model for the websearch config location.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 独立网页搜索：零依赖 MCP server，AnySearch / Exa / Parallel / Bing 自动回退，另带静态网页正文读取；所有引擎免 Key 可用。配置（引擎顺序、各引擎 Key）写在插件数据目录的 websearch.json——首次使用自动生成，装好后直接问模型「websearch 配置在哪」即可拿到具体路径。

plugins.name: model-speed
plugins.description: Show the current model's output speed (tokens/s) in the composer toolbar, scoped per session, using ZCode's built-in generation metrics. No API key, no network, no telemetry.

description_i18n.en: Show the current model's output speed (tokens/s) in the composer toolbar, scoped per session, using ZCode's built-in generation metrics. No API key, no network, no telemetry.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在输入框工具栏显示当前模型的输出速度（tokens/s），按会话区分，数据来自 ZCode 内置生成指标。不需要 API Key、不发网络请求、无遥测。

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.description: Local code graph for ZCode as a zero-dependency MCP server: tree-sitter index of 35 languages kept in SQLite under the plugin data folder, exposed through codegraph_status, codegraph_lookup (symbol search, callers, callees, impact, outline, import cycles, affected tests) and codegraph_map, so the model reads exact line ranges instead of grepping and reading whole files. The index is built or refreshed silently when a session opens; SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse hooks tell the model when the graph is ready and when to use it. No network, no telemetry.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 本地代码图谱：零依赖 MCP server，用随包的 tree-sitter 把 35 行语言索引成符号/引用/调用图，存进插件数据目录的 SQLite；codegraph_status、codegraph_lookup（符号搜索、调用者、被调用者、影响面、大纲）、codegraph_map 三个工具直接给出精确 file:line，替代 Grep 加整文件 Read。索引在会话打开时自动建立或刷新；SessionStart、UserPromptSubmit、PostToolUse 三个钩子告诉模型图谱何时就绪、何时该用它。零遥测、零外联、不执行项目代码；需 Node ≥ 22.13，钩子只认 PATH。

plugins.name: appearance
plugins.description: Background pictures or videos and colour skins for the ZCode desktop window, whole page or conversation area only, with tint, blur and rotation. ZCode gives plugins no way to restyle the app itself, so an external launcher (plugins/appearance/bin/launch.mjs) starts ZCode with its debugging channel and injects the styles; start ZCode from the launcher after quitting it completely. A view in the side pane changes every setting at once; /appearance does the same from the conversation; the settings live in ~/.zcode/appearance/config.json.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 桌面端自定义背景与配色皮肤：图片或视频可以铺整页或只换会话区，带遮罩、模糊、定时轮换，另有内置皮肤与自定义皮肤。ZCode 的插件接口碰不到应用外壳，所以由外置启动器带调试通道启动 ZCode 并注入样式——要先完全退出 ZCode，再从启动器启动。侧边栏的面板里每个设置改了就生效，/appearance 在对话里改，设置在 ~/.zcode/appearance/config.json。
